profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Zillow
profile.summary:
10+ years of backend Python, Go, and Java experience developing high-impact platforms, APIs, and services in the financial, real estate, and women’s health sectors. My roles have allowed me to wear many hats: software engineer, product owner, mentor, project manager, technical recruiter and people leader. 

I enjoy developing my technical expertise in areas I haven’t worked previously — a self-starter with a knack for figuring out complex systems on my own. I have a tendency to take ownership of anything I work on with a proven track record in leading strategy, scoping, implementation and product delivery for software builds. 

I have a passion for helping women become better represented in STEM roles — assisting with recruiting engineers, conducting technical interviews, mentoring new hires, and speaking on panels about navigating the tech industry as a woman. I’ve worked on global, cross-functional teams my entire career, at companies large and small, with teammates spanning Mumbai, London, Hong Kong, San Francisco and New York. I have a keen interest in working directly with business stakeholders to build more performant, scalable systems and to gain an in-depth understanding of what features are most relevant for the client experience.

- SME for all patient questionnaires builds

positions.description:

- Collaborated with global team of engineers, PMs, sales and traders in investment bank to rapidly develop and expand ever-changing internal platform for pricing, risk and trade management (1000s of daily releases by 4000+ devs)

positions.description:
Investment Banking Technology
--------------------------------
- Built tooling which automated the removal of deprecated databases from codebase

- Established multi-year engineer recruiting effort for University of Michigan by participating in Computer Science Industry panels and Career Fairs, including Women in Tech event (gEECS)
- Spearheaded Grace Hopper post-conference workstream by organizing Winning Women onsite recruiting event where we networked with and interviewed 50 female STEM students

positions.title: Assistant in Research
